items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: And the Iceman, you had no fridges there, the Iceman used to pack the, you know, the packed ice on the meat.

ctx.x: And, yeah, yeah, and you would play just around in this little section?

Right in the alley, you see they had a bar in like a little nightclub, you could call it, right in the back. Like the bar, you come into the alley between the market and the Steinmetz and Ocean's store, and as you come in through that alley like that, you come into, it'd be like a regular bar, you know? I see, yeah. Of course, that would control the people off now by having that seminar circles, and the circle people, they come in there later years after. But I'm bringing it back to a time when you had, the meat…
That's what, yeah, everybody would come every morning and do their shopping.
